items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: He had Junior Ragland and Al Lucas, but Junior Ragland would get drunk

ctx.x: But everybody had to play and pay attention. Like there was another time when Duke said -- he had two bass players. He had Junior Ragland and Al Lucas, but Junior Ragland would get drunk, so Duke said, 'I'd better hire another bass player so I can be sure I have one.'
